_comment: Canonical client metrics-config TEMPLATE. Copied into clients/<slug>/_brand/ at onboarding, then filled by sheets-provisioner. The Modal cron + Pentagon skills read the LIVE client copy (not this template) to know which sheet/tabs to update. See skills/sheets-provisioner/SKILL.md for the build sequence.
_tabs_doctrine: CORE (every client gets these): daily_calls, weekly_calls, monthly_calls, kpis, appt, creatives, avatars, copy, obf_data. OPTIONAL (add only when relevant): lp_funnel(+weekly/+monthly) = client has a landing page; creatives_test + copy_test = client runs 10-5-5 test-wave discipline; a form-response tab (named for the client's own tool, e.g. TALLY FORM) = client captures leads via an embedded form. Clone the live tabs from a template workbook with scripts/provision_from_template.py, then record the real gids into campaigns[].tabs.

provisioning._comment: Identities that touch this client's sheets. Creator = human OAuth via the gws CLI (a bare service account cannot create Sheets — it has no Drive). Writer = the metrics-cron service account. find_or_create_sheet.sh reads share_editors[] as default share targets. Leave service_account as TBD to defer the cron — sheet creation + manual avatar/copy writes only need the creator.

share_editors.note: service account — metrics cron writer (omit until provisioned)

meta._comment_campaign_filter: Set this when LP funnel tabs should report on a specific campaign only. Omit/empty for account-level totals.

tabs._comment: Schema library for the canonical tabs. Provisioning copies the relevant entries (with real gids) into campaigns[].tabs. CORE first; OPTIONAL blocks are prefixed _optional_ and are NOT live until you move them out and fill the gid.

appt.name: APPT
appt._note: Appointment log. Two header rows (keep=2 when cloning). Manually maintained.

creatives.name: CREATIVES
creatives._canva_link_convention: One Canva doc per DCT (1080x1080, 3 image variants per doc). User fills CANVA LINK manually after building the Canva doc; ad_concept_sheet_writer.py writes it from dct-tracker.json if populated there.
creatives._col_note: 16-col live shape. 'Why am I testing this?' sits at index 7 between ANGLE and PERSONA. The older 15-col shape (no that column) is stale — use 16.

copy.name: COPY
copy._col_note: 6-col live default (3-2-2 era, BATCH-prefixed). For 10-5-5 clients the wide variant is 12-col: BATCH, STATUS, COPY 1-5, HEADLINE 1-5 — widen the tab before a 10-5-5 wave if you want one row per DCT instead of one row per angle.

avatars.name: AVATARS
avatars._format_note: Canonical = narrative-per-row: header [AVATAR | NARRATIVE | LAST UPDATED], then one row per avatar with the full markdown profile in the NARRATIVE cell. Written by scripts/source_of_truth_sheet_writer.py from clients/<slug>/source-of-truth-draft.json.

obf_data.name: OBF DATA
obf_data._note: Order/booking-form or misc manual ops data tab.

_optional_lp_funnel._comment: OPTIONAL — only for clients with a landing page. Provision via scripts/modal/setup/provision_lp_tabs.py --client-slug <slug> --label <Label>, then move these three blocks up alongside the core tabs with their real gids. Skip entirely for clients whose funnel has no LP (e.g. IG/DM -> WhatsApp -> consult).

_optional_10x5x5_test._comment: OPTIONAL — only for clients running 10-5-5 test-wave discipline (test creative writes here, never on the live CREATIVES/COPY). Clone CREATIVES_10x5x5_TEST + COPY_10x5x5_TEST from the template workbook and record gids here, moved out of this _optional_ wrapper.

_optional_form_tab._comment: OPTIONAL — clients capturing leads via an embedded form get one manual tab named for THEIR tool. Do not hardcode a tool. Example for a Tally.so client, moved out of this wrapper: "tally_form": { "gid": "<gid>", "name": "TALLY FORM", "write_mode": "manual", "source": "tally_form_responses" }.
